## Methods notes

- `calc.add`: Images were added per-pixel with saturation with JSharp calc.add.
- `calc.and`: Images were combined per-pixel with bitwise AND with JSharp calc.and.
- `calc.blend`: Images were blended at the stated weight with JSharp calc.blend.
- `calc.not`: Images were inverted per-pixel with JSharp calc.not.
- `calc.or`: Images were combined per-pixel with bitwise OR with JSharp calc.or.
- `calc.subtract`: Images were subtracted per-pixel with saturation with JSharp calc.subtract.
- `calc.xor`: Images were combined per-pixel with bitwise XOR with JSharp calc.xor.
- `color.convert`: Images were converted to the stated color space with JSharp color.convert.
- `filter.blur`: Images were box-blurred with JSharp filter.blur.
- `filter.custom-kernel`: Images were convolved with a custom kernel with JSharp filter.custom-kernel.
- `filter.double-convolution`: Images were double-convolved with JSharp filter.double-convolution.
- `filter.edge-detection`: Edges were detected with JSharp filter.edge-detection.
- `filter.gaussian-blur`: Images were Gaussian-blurred with JSharp filter.gaussian-blur.
- `filter.median`: Images were median-filtered with JSharp filter.median.
- `geometry.flip-180`: Images were rotated 180 degrees with JSharp geometry.flip-180.
- `geometry.pyramid-down`: Images were downsampled with JSharp geometry.pyramid-down.
- `geometry.pyramid-up`: Images were upsampled with JSharp geometry.pyramid-up.
- `geometry.rotate-90`: Images were rotated 90 degrees clockwise with JSharp geometry.rotate-90.
- `measure.histogram`: The grayscale histogram was recorded with JSharp measure.histogram.
- `measure.particles`: Particles were recorded within the stated area bounds with JSharp measure.particles.
- `measure.profile`: The profile line was sampled with JSharp measure.profile.
- `morph.close`: Images were morphologically closed with JSharp morph.close.
- `morph.dilate`: Images were dilated with JSharp morph.dilate.
- `morph.erode`: Images were eroded with JSharp morph.erode.
- `morph.open`: Images were morphologically opened with JSharp morph.open.
- `point.equalize-histogram`: Images were histogram-equalized with JSharp point.equalize-histogram (histogram recomputed from the replay source).
- `point.negate`: Images were inverted with JSharp point.negate (bitwise NOT).
- `point.posterize`: Images were posterized to the stated level count with JSharp point.posterize.
- `point.stretch-contrast`: Images were contrast-stretched with JSharp point.stretch-contrast.
- `point.stretch-histogram`: Images were histogram-stretched with JSharp point.stretch-histogram.
- `segment.grabcut`: The foreground was cut inside the stated rectangle with JSharp segment.grabcut.
- `segment.hough`: Line segments were drawn with JSharp segment.hough.
- `segment.inpaint`: Masked regions were reconstructed at the stated radius with JSharp segment.inpaint.
- `segment.skeletonize`: Images were skeletonized with JSharp segment.skeletonize.
- `segment.watershed`: Images were segmented with JSharp segment.watershed.
- `threshold.adaptive`: Images were adaptively thresholded with JSharp threshold.adaptive.
- `threshold.dual`: Images were dual-thresholded to the stated band with JSharp threshold.dual.
- `threshold.simple`: Images were thresholded at the stated level with JSharp threshold.simple.
